pages.title: Frayed Thread
pages.text: Every quest returns a little **Frayed Thread** — scraps of the Loom that still hold. Unravel one for three string. Or keep it: the **Frayed Thread Desk** (a quest chapter) sells saplings, buckets, meshes, pearls, and other things a pad runs short of.

pages.title: Codex Pages
pages.text:
Every third Strand a Clowder seats, a **Codex Page** slips free — a margin note from that tribe. Right-click to read it. Pages are kept, not spent.

The Desk sells a few loose ones too. Those pick a tribe on their own.
